hi_dev_mt: 1453 ई. में ओटोमन तुर्कों ने किस शहर पर विजय प्राप्त की थी?
hi_rom_std: 1453 i. men otoman turkon ne kis shahar par vijay prapt ki thi?
gold_source_answer_en: The city of Constantinople (modern-day Istanbul) was conquered by the Ottoman Turks in 1453.

en: In 1802, which Peshwa signed a troop agreement with the British?
hi_dev_mt: 1802 में किस पेशवा ने अंग्रेजों के साथ सैन्य समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
hi_rom_std: 1802 men kis peshva ne angrejon ke sath sainya samjhaute par hastakshar kie?
gold_source_answer_en: Baji Rao II signed the Treaty of Bassein on December 31, 1802.

en: Jamshedji Tata established the steel manufacturing plant of Tata Iron and Steel Company at which place?
hi_dev_mt: जमशेदजी टाटा ने टाटा आयरन एंड स्टील कंपनी का इस्पात विनिर्माण संयंत्र किस स्थान पर स्थापित किया?
hi_rom_std: Jamashedji tata ne tata ayran end stil kanpni ka ispat vinirman sanyantra kis sthan par sthapit kiya?
gold_source_answer_en: Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO) was founded by Jamsetji Tata and established by Dorabji Tata at Jamshedpur.

en: Which author wrote the book Gitarahasya?
hi_dev_mt: गीतारहस्य पुस्तक किस लेखक ने लिखी?
hi_rom_std: Gitarahasya pustak kis lekhak ne likhi?
gold_source_answer_en: Lokmanya Balgangadhar Tilak wrote Shrimadh Bhagvad Gita Rahasya in prison at Mandalay – the analysis of Karma Yoga in the Bhagavad Gita, which is known to be a gift of the Vedas and the Upanishads.

en: Rabindranath Tagore renounced which title given by the government to protest the Jallianwala Bagh massacre?
hi_dev_mt: रवींद्रनाथ टैगोर ने जलियांवाला बाग हत्याकांड के विरोध में सरकार द्वारा दी गई कौन सी उपाधि को त्याग दिया?
hi_rom_std: Ravindranath taigor ne jaliyanvala bag hatyakand ke virodh men sarkar dvara di gai kaun si upadhi ko tyag diya?
gold_source_answer_en: Rabindranath Tagore was awarded Knighthood for Services to Literature by King George V in 1915. Tagore renounced his title of Knighthood after the 1919 Jallianwala Bagh Massacre.

en: Which Bhosale president signed the "Treaty of Nagpur" with the British?
hi_dev_mt: किस भोसले राष्ट्रपति ने अंग्रेजों के साथ "नागपुर की संधि" पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
hi_rom_std: Kis bhosle rashtrapti ne angrejon ke sath "nagpur ki sandhi" par hastakshar kie?
gold_source_answer_en: The Treaty of Nagpur took place in 1816. Between Bhosale president Appa Saheb and British governor-general Lord Hastings.

en: In which year Ahmednagar fort was captured by General Wellesley, promoting British power in the region?
hi_dev_mt: किस वर्ष जनरल वेलेस्ली ने अहमदनगर किले पर कब्जा कर लिया, जिससे इस क्षेत्र में ब्रिटिश शक्ति को बढ़ावा मिला?
hi_rom_std: Kis varsh janral velesli ne ahamadangar kile par kabja kar liya, jisse is kshetra men british shakti ko badhava mila?
gold_source_answer_en: The Ahmednagar Fort was captured by General Wellesley in 1803, promoting British power in the region.

en: Shivaji Maharaj was coronated in which year?
hi_dev_mt: शिवाजी महाराज का राज्याभिषेक किस वर्ष हुआ था?
hi_rom_std: Shivaji maharaj ka rajyabhishek kis varsh hua tha?
gold_source_answer_en: Shivaji Maharaj was coronated in 1674.

en: Khandesh region was captured by Mughal Emperor Akbar in which year?
hi_dev_mt: खानदेश क्षेत्र पर मुगल सम्राट अकबर ने किस वर्ष कब्जा किया था?
hi_rom_std: Khandesh kshetra par mugal samrat akbar ne kis varsh kabja kiya tha?
gold_source_answer_en: The Khandesh region was captured by Mughal Emperor Akbar in 1601.

en: Who defeated Marathas in the third battle of Panipat?
hi_dev_mt: पानीपत की तीसरी लड़ाई में मराठों को किसने हराया?
hi_rom_std: Panipat ki tisri ladai men marathon ko kisne haraya?
gold_source_answer_en: The Marathas were defeated by the Durrani Empire, led by Ahmad Shah Abdali, in the Third Battle of Panipat in 1761.

en: Which Maratha king's court poet composed the heroic epic Shivabharata?
hi_dev_mt: किस मराठा राजा के दरबारी कवि ने वीर महाकाव्य शिवभारत की रचना की थी?
hi_rom_std: Kis maratha raja ke darbari kavi ne vir mahakavya shivabharat ki rachna ki thi?
gold_source_answer_en: The heroic epic Shivabharata was composed by the court poet of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.

en: The Wadgaon Agreement or Pact was concluded between which war?
hi_dev_mt: वडगांव समझौता या संधि किस युद्ध के बीच हुई थी?
hi_rom_std: Vadganv samjhauta ya sandhi kis yuddh ke bich hui thi?
gold_source_answer_en: The Wadgaon Agreement was concluded during the First Anglo-Maratha War.

en: Gavilgarh fort was built by which king in AD 1425?
hi_dev_mt: गाविलगढ़ किला 1425 ई. में किस राजा द्वारा बनवाया गया था?
hi_rom_std: Gavilgadh kila 1425 i. men kis raja dvara banvaya gaya tha?
gold_source_answer_en: Gavilgarh Fort was built by Ahmad Shah Bahmani in AD 1425.

en: The words “Satyameva Jayate” in the State Emblem adopted by the Government of India have been taken from which Upanishad?
hi_dev_mt: भारत सरकार द्वारा अपनाए गए राज्य प्रतीक में "सत्यमेव जयते" शब्द किस उपनिषद से लिए गए हैं?
hi_rom_std: Bharat sarkar dvara apanae gae rajya pratik men "satyamev jayte" shabd kis upanishad se lie gae hain?
gold_source_answer_en: The words “Satyameva Jayate” are taken from the Mundaka Upanishad.

en: In which caves is the Kailasha temple located?
hi_dev_mt: कैलाश मंदिर किस गुफा में स्थित है?
hi_rom_std: Kailash mandir kis gupha men sthit hai?
gold_source_answer_en: The Kailasha temple is located in the Ellora caves.

en: When did the Lahore Congress, under the presidency of Jawaharlal Nehru, formalise the demand of ‘Purna Swaraj’ or full independence for India?
hi_dev_mt: जवाहरलाल नेहरू की अध्यक्षता में लाहौर कांग्रेस ने भारत के लिए 'पूर्ण स्वराज' या पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता की मांग को औपचारिक रूप कब दिया?
hi_rom_std: Javaharlal nehru ki adhyakshata men lahaur kangres ne bharat ke lie 'purn svaraj' ya purn svatantrata ki mang ko aupacharik rup kab diya?
gold_source_answer_en: The demand for ‘Purna Swaraj’ was formalized in December 1929 at the Lahore Congress.

en: Which Anglo - Maratha wars resulted in merging the Peshwas' territories with the Bombay Presidency?
hi_dev_mt: कौन से एंग्लो-मराठा युद्धों के परिणामस्वरूप पेशवाओं के क्षेत्रों को बॉम्बे प्रेसीडेंसी में मिला दिया गया?
hi_rom_std: Kaun se englo-maratha yuddh_on ke parinamasvarup peshavaon ke kshetron ko bombe presidensi men mila diya gaya?
gold_source_answer_en: The Third Anglo-Maratha War resulted in merging the Peshwas' territories with Bombay Presidency.

en: The Gandhi — Irwin Pact was associated to which of the following movements of India?
hi_dev_mt: गांधी-इरविन समझौता भारत के निम्नलिखित में से किस आंदोलन से संबंधित था?
hi_rom_std: Gandhi-irvin samjhauta bharat ke nimnalikhit men se kis andolan se sanbandhit tha?
gold_source_answer_en: The Gandhi-Irwin Pact was associated with the Civil Disobedience Movement.

en: Name the epic poem written by Valmiki.
hi_dev_mt: वाल्मीकि द्वारा लिखित महाकाव्य का नाम बताइए।
hi_rom_std: Valmiki dvara likhit mahakavya ka nam bataie.
gold_source_answer_en: The Ramayana

en: Which Indian author won the Nobel Prize in Literature?
hi_dev_mt: किस भारतीय लेखक ने साहित्य में नोबेल पुरस्कार जीता?
hi_rom_std: Kis bhartiy lekhak ne sahitya men nobel puraskar jita?
gold_source_answer_en: Rabindranath Tagore became the first person from India and Asia to receive the Nobel Prize.

en: Who is the author of the Tamil novel "Silappadhikaram"?
hi_dev_mt: तमिल उपन्यास "सिलप्पाधिकारम" के लेखक कौन हैं?
hi_rom_std: Tamil upanyas "silappadhikaram" ke lekhak kaun hain?
gold_source_answer_en: Ilango Adigal
notes: source calls it a 'novel'; it is an epic. Answer unaffected

en: Who is the author of the Kannada novel "Vamsavriksha"?
hi_dev_mt: कन्नड़ उपन्यास "वंशवृक्ष" के लेखक कौन हैं?
hi_rom_std: Kannad upanyas "vanshavriksh" ke lekhak kaun hain?
gold_source_answer_en: S. L. Bhyrappa

en: Which city is called “Detroit of India” for its automobiles industry?
hi_dev_mt: किस शहर को उसके ऑटोमोबाइल उद्योग के लिए “भारत का डेट्रायट” कहा जाता है?
hi_rom_std: Kis shahar ko uske otomobail udyog ke lie “bharat ka detrayat” kaha jata hai?
gold_source_answer_en: Chennai is nicknamed the “Detroit of Asia” (or the “Detroit of India”). This is due to the presence of major automobile manufacturing units and allied industries around the city. In USA most of the automobile manufacturing industries are around USA.
notes: Pune is also occasionally called this; Chennai is standard

en: In which year, Planning Commission was set up?
hi_dev_mt: योजना आयोग की स्थापना किस वर्ष की गई थी?
hi_rom_std: Yojna ayog ki sthapna kis varsh ki gai thi?
gold_source_answer_en: India set up the Planning Commission in 1950 to oversee the entire range of planning, including resource allocation, implementation and appraisal of five-year plans. The idea of 5 year plan was taken from soviet union.

en: Which state has the highest Gross State Domestic Product(GSDP) in India?
hi_dev_mt: भारत में किस राज्य का सकल राज्य घरेलू उत्पाद (जीएसडीपी) सबसे अधिक है?
hi_rom_std: Bharat men kis rajya ka sakal rajya gharelu utpad (jiesdipi) sabse adhik hai?
gold_source_answer_en: Maharashtra has the highest GSDP among the states and UT’s. It contributes 14.11% of total India’s GDP at current prices followed by Tamil Nadu (8.55%).
notes: stable for decades; not explicitly dated

en: Which organization launched the School Education Quality Index?
hi_dev_mt: किस संगठन ने स्कूल शिक्षा गुणवत्ता सूचकांक लॉन्च किया?
hi_rom_std: Kis sangthan ne skul shiksha gunavatta suchkank lonch kiya?
gold_source_answer_en: NITI Aayog launched the School Education Quality Index(SEQI). SEQI comprises a set of indicators that critically influence the overall effectiveness and efficiency of the school education sector.

en: What is the total income support provided annually under Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) Scheme?
hi_dev_mt: प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि (पीएम-किसान) योजना के तहत प्रतिवर्ष प्रदान की जाने वाली कुल आय सहायता कितनी है?
hi_rom_std: Pradhanamantri kisan samman nidhi (piem-kisan) yojna ke tahat prativarsh pradan ki jane vali kul ay sahayta kitni hai?
gold_source_answer_en: The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) Scheme was launched in 2019 to provide income support to all landholder farmer families across the country with cultivable land, subject to certain exclusions. Under the Scheme, an amount of Rs. 6000 per year is released in three instalments of Rs. 2000 each directly into the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.

en: What are the reserves maintained by commercial banks with the Reserve Bank of India over and above the statutory minimum called?
hi_dev_mt: वाणिज्यिक बैंकों द्वारा भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक के पास वैधानिक न्यूनतम से अधिक रखी गई आरक्षित निधियों को क्या कहा जाता है?
hi_rom_std: Vanijyik bainkon dvara bhartiy rijarva baink ke pas vaidhanik nyuntam se adhik rakhi gai arakshit nidhiyon ko kya kaha jata hai?
gold_source_answer_en: In banking, excess reserves are bank reserves in excess of the reserve requirement set by a central bank. They are reserves of cash more than the required amounts.

en: What is the investment made by foreign companies in our country called?
hi_dev_mt: हमारे देश में विदेशी कंपनियों द्वारा किए गए निवेश को क्या कहा जाता है?
hi_rom_std: Hamare desh men videshi kanpniyo dvara kie gae nivesh ko kya kaha jata hai?
gold_source_answer_en: Foreign direct investment (FDI) takes place when a company, multinational corporation or individual from one country invests in another country's assets or takes an ownership stake in its companies.

en: When was Employment Guarantee Scheme (EGS) introduced in Maharashtra?
hi_dev_mt: महाराष्ट्र में रोजगार गारंटी योजना (ईजीएस) कब शुरू की गई?
hi_rom_std: Maharashtra men rojgar garanti yojna (ijies) kab shuru ki gai?
gold_source_answer_en: Employment Guarantee Scheme (EGS) was introduced on 28th March, 1972.
notes: scheme 1972; the EGS Act followed in 1977

en: What is the nature of India's economy?
hi_dev_mt: भारत की अर्थव्यवस्था की प्रकृति क्या है?
hi_rom_std: Bharat ki arthavyavastha ki prakriti kya hai?
gold_source_answer_en: India is a mixed economy. It is characterized by a reliance on agriculture and industry, low per capita income, a large population, unemployment, unequal wealth distribution, and infrastructure deficiencies. The majority of the Indian workforce is employed in these sectors, reflecting the country's economic development stage.
